ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized to distal regions, estimated at a 1:6 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling and vertical streaking concentrated on the distal 20% of both the left and right lobes; the central 60% of the fluke area is a solid low-intensity black contiguous block.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped central depression with a vertical depth of approximately 5% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude variations; notable deep scalloped indentation on the right lobe medial to the tip and multiple sharp, jagged peaks across the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curve originating from the peduncle and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast brownish-white clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and erosion along the trailing edge, characterized by deep indentations and jagged contours compared to a standard smooth arc.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive protruding biological accretions localized at the farthest distal points of both lobes, creating a distinct bulbous silhouette at the tips.
